command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0070/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All eight 0.41.0 rows: the four plain-base rows twice (at %rax/%rdi and %r8/%r15) and the four fixed %rsp/%r12 rows once each, twelve instructions and 46 bytes. This is the mod = 00 shape with the 0x66 operand-size prefix before REX: the two-byte prefix rows are 66 8b 00 (three bytes) and the REX.B rows are 66 41 8b 00 (four), while the %rsp row is 66 8b 04 24 (four) and the %r12 row is 66 41 8b 04 24 (five). There is no displacement and no displacement slot. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 46-byte .text.
